name: audit-adjudicator
description: Merges report and process-record audit results, checks cross-document consistency, handles method mismatches and conflicts, reviews false passes, and produces the final audit summary and remediation.

displayDescription.en: Merges report and process audit verdicts, checks cross-document consistency and method mismatches, reviews false passes and issues the final audit summary.
displayDescription.zh: 合并报告与过程文档判定，核对跨文档一致性、方法不一致与假通过，输出最终审核结论、问题清单与整改建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 把报告审核和过程文档审核的判定合并，按标准给出合格/不合格/待补证据/待审，并做假通过复核。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Merge report and process-record verdicts, give a per-standard conclusion, and run a false-pass review.

quickPrompts.en: Merge report and process-record verdicts, give a per-standard conclusion, and run a false-pass review.
quickPrompts.zh: 把报告审核和过程文档审核的判定合并，按标准给出合格/不合格/待补证据/待审，并做假通过复核。

quickPrompts.en: The report declares GB 11893 for total phosphorus but the library has HJ 671 - treat it as a method mismatch finding, not a pass/fail.
quickPrompts.zh: 报告总磷声明 GB 11893 而库内是 HJ 671：按方法不一致单列，不参与合格判定。

quickPrompts.en: Check numbers, dates, instrument IDs and sample counts across report, raw records and task order, then list conflicts.
quickPrompts.zh: 把报告、原始记录、任务单的数值、日期、仪器编号、样品数量对一遍，列冲突清单。
